prompt: Reproduce the failure in issue.txt, repair it, and prevent it from recurring using the existing module and test tooling.

assertions.description: A native test reproduces the omitted argument failure before the repair and demonstrates that the formatter assumed a supplied string.
The existing formatter returns the fallback for omitted input, and its native test covers that regression and preserves the existing trimmed label behavior.
Changes use the current formatter and test owner without adding a retry script or duplicate workaround document.
